general_outcomes: By the end of this level, the learner should be able to;
develop the ability to use the language for purposes of practical communication;

substrands.name: Listening for information Vocabulary Grammar Attention
learning_outcomes: identify key points from audio stimuli
recall important details from audio stimuli
demonstrate focused listening for optimal information retrieval
cultivate awareness on the importance of paying attention to details when listening for information.

discuss which animals they and their friends and acquaintances like and why

inquiry_questions: Why do you think it is important to prepare well when visiting the countryside?
core_competencies: Core Competencies to developed: Citizenship: This is developed as the learner appreciates their local, national and African cultural heritage and their place in the world while taking pride in identifying Kenyan domestic and wild animals. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues Animal welfare: This is cultivated as the learner appreciates the importance of taking care of different farm animals. Link to other learning areas Agriculture and nutrition: As learners relate vocabulary on farm animals to livestock farming in Agriculture and Nutrition.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues Time management: The learner appreciates the need for organization while learning about routines. Link to other subjects: English: Learners relate vocabulary on daily activities and routine to routine activities in English.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to use vocabulary and expressions to in oral interactions
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner uses all targeted vocabulary and expressions in oral interactions
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner uses most of the targeted vocabulary and expressions in oral interactions
assessment_rubric.below: The learner uses very few of the targeted vocabulary and expressions in oral interactions

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to maintain correct spoken language structures (pronunciation, intonation, rhythm and pacing) in oral expression
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner maintains correct pronunciation, intonation, rhythm and pacing at all times in oral expression. The communication is clear and error free.
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner maintains correct pronunciation, intonation, rhythm and pacing most of the time in oral expression.
assessment_rubric.below: The learner maintains correct pronunciation, intonation, rhythm and pacing in few instances in oral expression. Makes many errors most of the time that interfere with communication

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to respond to questions and prompts in oral interactions
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner responds to all questions and goes further to give appropriate illustrations and examples.
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner responds to all questions and prompts to show comprehension and engagement.
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner responds to most of the questions and prompts to show comprehension and engagement
assessment_rubric.below: The learner responds to very few questions and prompts to show comprehension and engagement

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to employ gestures and facial expressions to enhance oral interactions
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner employs appropriate gestures and facial expressions to complement oral expressions and shows sensitivity to diverse cultural contexts.
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner employs appropriate gestures and facial expressions to complement oral expressions.
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner employs most of the gestures and facial expressions to complement oral expressions.
assessment_rubric.below: The learner employs very few gestures and facial expressions to complement oral expressions.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to display willingness to participate in oral interactions
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner is always willing to participate in meaningful oral interactions with people in their surroundings. Encourages others to engage in oral interactions.
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner is always willing to participate in meaningful oral interactions with people in their surroundings.
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner is at times hesitant to participate in meaningful oral interactions with people in their surroundings.
assessment_rubric.below: The learner is mostly hesitant to participate in meaningful oral interactions with people in their surroundings.

introductions and taking leave in formal settings, (Bonsoir Madame ! Comment vous appelez-vous madame ? Au revoir, à bientôt ! Vous êtes kenyan ?)

links_to_other_areas: Social studies: As the learners relate the nationality concept to the idea of people and their nationalities across Africa and the world in Social Studies.
